The diagram shows the outline of a keyhole consisting of three straight sides and an arc from a circle.
The sides $PQ$ and $RS$ are both $18 \text{ mm}$ in length and when extended meet at the centre of the circle $O$ forming an angle of $\frac{\pi}{6}$ radians.
The longer arc from $Q$ to $R$ has length $22\pi \text{ mm}$.
What is the area, in $\text{mm}^2$, of the keyhole as shaded in the diagram?
